Zoe - People Ops: Quick question: Liam wants to move Kai to a new team and promote to SWE III same day. Can we do transfer + promo on one effective date and fast-track comp approval?
Liam - Eng Manager: Yes, retention risk. External offer in 7 days. What do we need to trigger a fast review?
Comp-Fastlane Bot: Fastlane process: submit full Comp Packet and check 'Fastlane - retention'. Attach offer or documented risk + 2 peer calibrations. Fastlane aims for 24-48 hrs but not guaranteed. Standard committee meets weekly.
Kai - IC: If approved after payroll cutoff, will I get retro pay?
Zoe - People Ops: Yes — if approvals miss payroll cutoff we'll process retro pay next cycle. Payroll cutoff is the 18th at 5pm PT. Keep backdates within 30 days to avoid audit review.
Liam - Eng Manager: Thresholds? When do we need Finance or budget-owner sign-off?
Ben - Finance: In-band adjustments (<=10%) handled by People Ops. 10-20% go to Comp Chair. >20% requires Finance approval and budget owner acknowledgement. Fastlane can include Finance if you flag urgency and provide funding code.
Kai - IC: Equity / refresh implications?
Zoe - People Ops: Promotion doesn't auto-trigger off-cycle equity. If you want a refresh or make-whole, mark 'Equity request' in packet and we'll route to Rewards.
Liam - Eng Manager: Appeal path if committee denies?
Zoe - People Ops: Manager Appeal: submit Appeal Request within 7 days with new evidence; Chair + independent Rewards reviewer re-evaluate. For retention cases we can request an ad-hoc reconvene within 48 hrs.
Comp-Fastlane Bot: Useful links: Comp Packet: https://redwood.infra/hr/comp-packet, Fastlane checklist: https://redwood.infra/hr/fastlane, Payroll cutoff: https://redwood.infra/hr/payroll-cutoffs
Zoe - People Ops: TL;DR: stacking transfer+promo allowed. Submit comp packet, check Fastlane for retention, attach offer, DM me the link and I'll escalate to Chair + Finance if needed.
Liam - Eng Manager: Filing now, will DM you the packet. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
